title: Breitkroniger Laubbaum A
description: Breiter Laubbaum mit dreifacher Stammgabel und modelliertem Wurzelanlauf. Rekursiv verzweigte Tragäste, Seitenäste und Endzweige erschließen eine unregelmäßige Krone ab etwa fünf Metern. Opake Blattspreiten bilden dunkles Innenlaub und hellere olivgrüne Außenseiten.

review.notes: Round 1, the strongest tree. Good: 15.6 m high with a 14 m crown (in the STYLE.md range), modelled leaves, darker underside, two-lobed crown, visible fork. Defects: (1) silhouette: a tall bare trunk carries one dense, closed crown mass (lollipop); STYLE.md asks for broad irregular crowns with air, so open gaps between 3-5 branch clusters and let main limbs show through the crown (ref_12/13). (2) The root flare is four flat, sharp-edged fins in a star (closeup_base tile); replace them with 5-7 rounded, uneven root spurs that sink into the ground. (3) Bark: tree_bark wants brown longitudinal furrows with 0.012 m relief, but the trunk is a smooth brown tube with faint streaks; build or displace readable furrows and add moss on the weather side. (4) The foliage reads dark blue-green, not olive (foliage_leaf); warm up the sunlit tops. (5) Branches above the fork are hidden; there is no branch structure in closeup_upper apart from a few thin twigs.
